title: Receive on site
intro: Prepare purchase orders on the phone while there is a signal, then record receipts on site even without one. They go by themselves once there is a signal again
offline: No signal: kept on the phone for now
signIn: Sign in first. Receipts kept on the phone go on once you sign in with the same account
moduleOff: Your organization has the BCS Go app off, so nothing new can be prepared or recorded. Receipts already kept still go

find.title: Find a purchase order
find.scan: Scan the QR on the purchase order
find.scanUnavailable: This phone cannot scan yet (Google's scanner is being installed). Try again with a signal, or type the purchase order number
find.typedHint: Type the number on the purchase order, e.g. PO-2569-00012
find.notBcs: This QR is not a BCS purchase order, so it was not opened or sent anywhere
find.notFound: This PO is not among those you may receive
find.notOnPhone: This purchase order is not on the phone. Try again with a signal, or prepare for receiving offline before going on site
find.fromServer: The latest from BCS, now kept on the phone

prepare.title: Purchase orders on this phone
prepare.done: {count, plural, one {# purchase order is} other {# purchase orders are}} ready to receive without a signal
prepare.none: No purchase order is on this phone yet
prepare.noneToReceive: No purchase order is waiting for you to receive right now
prepare.noneHint: Press Prepare for receiving offline while there is a signal, before you go on site
prepare.truncated: Your organization lets a phone keep {count}. Receive the others while there is a signal
prepare.keepRefused: This phone may clear receipts not sent yet when it runs low on space. Send them soon once there is a signal
prepare.failed: Could not prepare. Check the signal and try again
prepare.old: This copy is older than {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}. Prepare again while there is a signal before recording

form.title: Receipt for {number}
form.photoUnreadable: This photo could not be read. Take it again
form.photoLimit: A receipt takes at most {count} photos
form.notKept: This phone could not keep it (a private window, or no space left), so nothing was saved
form.fixAbove: Fix the fields marked above before saving
form.saved: Kept on this phone. It goes by itself once there is a signal
form.savedOnline: Kept on this phone. Sending now
form.goneMeanwhile: This receipt went while you were correcting it, so the correction was not kept. See how it went in the queue

queue.title: Waiting to send
queue.empty: Nothing is waiting on this phone
queue.emptyHint: Receipts recorded without a signal stay here until they are sent
queue.held: {count, plural, one {# receipt} other {# receipts}} of another user {count, plural, one {is} other {are}} on this phone. They are not sent with your account
queue.waitingSignIn: {count, plural, one {# receipt is} other {# receipts are}} waiting on this phone.
queue.deleteHeldTitle: Delete {count, plural, one {# receipt} other {# receipts}} of another user?

reason.CONFLICT_VERSION: The purchase order changed while there was no signal. Prepare again and see what was received last before recording again
reason.INVALID_STATE_TRANSITION: This purchase order takes no more goods (cancelled or fully received)
reason.FORBIDDEN: This account cannot send this receipt
reason.SOD_VIOLATION: Separation of duties does not let you receive this purchase order. Ask another receiver
reason.BUDGET_INSUFFICIENT: Not enough budget for the excess. Contact procurement
reason.VALIDATION_FAILED: What was recorded is incomplete or wrong. Correct it and record again
reason.NOT_FOUND: This purchase order was not found
reason.NOT_RECORDED: BCS has no record of this receipt. See the purchase order's latest receipt before recording again
reason.TYPE_NOT_ALLOWED: This photo cannot be sent. Take it out and take a new one
reason.TOO_LARGE: The photo is too large. Take it out and take a new one
reason.PHOTO_MISSING: A photo of this receipt is gone from the phone. Take it out and take a new one
reason.OTHER: Not sent. Correct it and record again, or throw it away

queue.refreshFirst: Prepare the purchase order again while there is a signal, then it can be corrected
queue.discardBody: The receipt and its photos are deleted from this phone and will not be sent

signOut.title: Sign out and delete what is on this phone?
signOut.notSent: {count, plural, one {# receipt} other {# receipts}} not sent yet will be lost
signOut.mayBeRecorded: {count, plural, one {# receipt} other {# receipts}} may be recorded. See the purchase order's latest receipt before recording again
signOut.rejected: {count, plural, one {# receipt was} other {# receipts were}} refused
signOut.nothing: Nothing is waiting on this phone
